**1. Applicable Tax Rate**
For domestic companies that opt for taxation under Section 115BAB, the rate of income-tax is **15%** of the total income [C2]. This regime is available as an option to domestic companies upon fulfillment of the conditions contained in Section 115BAB [C2].

**2. Surcharge**
The surcharge applicable to domestic companies whose income is chargeable to tax under Section 115BAB is **10%** [C2].

**3. Exclusion from Standard Surcharge Provisions**
The standard surcharge rates applicable to other domestic companies (7% for income exceeding ₹1 crore up to ₹10 crore, and 12% for income exceeding ₹10 crore) do **not** apply to companies opting for Section 115BAB [C1]. Similarly, the general surcharge provisions for domestic companies explicitly exclude those whose income is chargeable to tax under Section 115BAA or Section 115BAB [C3].

**4. Health and Education Cess**
For FY 2024-25, an additional surcharge known as the “Health and Education Cess on income-tax” is levied at the rate of **4%** on the amount of tax computed, inclusive of the surcharge (wherever applicable) [C1]. No marginal relief is available in respect of this cess [C1].

**5. Marginal Relief**
Marginal relief is provided in surcharge in all cases [C1].
